units.rawText: What a nag. I bet De Lacey wouldn't have said that much if Hatsuchiri had gone out on a mission by herself.

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: [Adjusting priorities...]
units.displayText: [Adjusting priorities...]

spans.text: [Adjusting priorities...]

units.rawText: I understand. I will take you to see the agents here.
units.displayText: I understand. I will take you to see the agents here.

spans.text: I understand. I will take you to see the agents here.

units.rawText: You'll take me?
units.displayText: You'll take me?

spans.text: You'll take me?

units.rawText: Yes. Just follow this passage.
units.displayText: Yes. Just follow this passage.

spans.text: Yes. Just follow this passage.

units.rawText: And how do I know you aren't going to pull more tricks?
units.displayText: And how do I know you aren't going to pull more tricks?

spans.text: And how do I know you aren't going to pull more tricks?

units.rawText: I will go with you. I will be with you.
units.displayText: I will go with you. I will be with you.

spans.text: I will go with you. I will be with you.

units.rawText: You can attack me at any time and disable me.
units.displayText: You can attack me at any time and disable me.

spans.text: You can attack me at any time and disable me.

units.rawText: ...Humph.
units.displayText: ...Humph.

spans.text: ...Humph.

units.rawText: Sueyoi waves his spear in lieu of a response. Taranum obediently opens a door.
units.displayText: Sueyoi waves his spear in lieu of a response. Taranum obediently opens a door.

spans.text: Sueyoi waves his spear in lieu of a response. Taranum obediently opens a door.

units.rawText: A jet-black passage is revealed before the two of them.
units.displayText: A jet-black passage is revealed before the two of them.

spans.text: A jet-black passage is revealed before the two of them.

units.rawText: You go first.
units.displayText: You go first.

spans.text: You go first.

units.rawText: Sure.
units.displayText: Sure.

spans.text: Sure.

units.rawText: With no way to tell where the passage is headed, Sueyoi tries his best to quash his feeling of unease.
units.displayText: With no way to tell where the passage is headed, Sueyoi tries his best to quash his feeling of unease.

spans.text: With no way to tell where the passage is headed, Sueyoi tries his best to quash his feeling of unease.

units.rawText: (Given the explanation she just gave and the environment here, this sector might really have given rise to the "objective"...)
units.displayText: Given the explanation she just gave and the environment here, this sector might really have given rise to the "objective"...

spans.text: Given the explanation she just gave and the environment here, this sector might really have given rise to the "objective"...

units.rawText: (Is that possible? Could the thing we've been pursuing for so long be found in an unassuming, small Sector like this?)
units.displayText: Is that possible? Could the thing we've been pursuing for so long be found in an unassuming, small Sector like this?

spans.text: Is that possible? Could the thing we've been pursuing for so long be found in an unassuming, small Sector like this?

units.rawText: (But if it's true... then perhaps we can prove...)
units.displayText: But if it's true... then perhaps we can prove...

spans.text: But if it's true... then perhaps we can prove...

units.rawText: Taranum suddenly comes to a halt. Sueyoi stops as well and looks ahead.
units.displayText: Taranum suddenly comes to a halt. Sueyoi stops as well and looks ahead.

spans.text: Taranum suddenly comes to a halt. Sueyoi stops as well and looks ahead.

units.rawText: Hey, what's wrong?
units.displayText: Hey, what's wrong?

spans.text: Hey, what's wrong?

units.rawText: ...There is no way forward.
units.displayText: ...There is no way forward.

spans.text: ...There is no way forward.

units.rawText: No way forward? Didn't you pick this route yourself?
units.displayText: No way forward? Didn't you pick this route yourself?

spans.text: No way forward? Didn't you pick this route yourself?

units.rawText: It's been blocked off.
units.displayText: It's been blocked off.

spans.text: It's been blocked off.

units.rawText: Blocked off? Aren't you the administrator here?
units.displayText: Blocked off? Aren't you the administrator here?

spans.text: Blocked off? Aren't you the administrator here?

units.rawText: As Sueyoi voices his questions, he walks past Taranum and heads forward—
units.displayText: As Sueyoi voices his questions, he walks past Taranum and heads forward—

spans.text: As Sueyoi voices his questions, he walks past Taranum and heads forward—

units.rawText: A purplish-black tide rains down from overhead, instantly paralyzing Sueyoi.
units.displayText: A purplish-black tide rains down from overhead, instantly paralyzing Sueyoi.

spans.text: A purplish-black tide rains down from overhead, instantly paralyzing Sueyoi.

units.rawText: —Liquid Entropy!?
units.displayText: —Liquid Entropy!?

spans.text: —Liquid Entropy!?

units.rawText: The tide immediately engulfs the place where the two of them are standing, and Sueyoi is washed away by the water.
units.displayText: The tide immediately engulfs the place where the two of them are standing, and Sueyoi is washed away by the water.

spans.text: The tide immediately engulfs the place where the two of them are standing, and Sueyoi is washed away by the water.

units.rawText: But how... I didn't even see her do anything...
units.displayText: But how... I didn't even see her do anything...

spans.text: But how... I didn't even see her do anything...

units.rawText: I got careless... But how could I possibly lose to the likes of...!
units.displayText: I got careless... But how could I possibly lose to the likes of...!

spans.text: I got careless... But how could I possibly lose to the likes of...!

units.rawText: Sueyoi's voice is gradually lost in the tide of liquid Entropy. Taranum watches for a few seconds, then looks away.
units.displayText: Sueyoi's voice is gradually lost in the tide of liquid Entropy. Taranum watches for a few seconds, then looks away.

spans.text: Sueyoi's voice is gradually lost in the tide of liquid Entropy. Taranum watches for a few seconds, then looks away.

units.rawText: (He didn't sink, but submerged himself?)
units.displayText: He didn't sink, but submerged himself?

spans.text: He didn't sink, but submerged himself?

units.rawText: (No matter what, there's no getting away from her.)
units.displayText: No matter what, there's no getting away from her.

spans.text: No matter what, there's no getting away from her.

units.rawText: ...Please forgive me.
units.displayText: ...Please forgive me.

spans.text: ...Please forgive me.

units.rawText: With that, Taranum leaves the pitch-black passage.
units.displayText: With that, Taranum leaves the pitch-black passage.

spans.text: With that, Taranum leaves the pitch-black passage.

units.rawText: The door closes behind her like a thunderclap.
units.displayText: The door closes behind her like a thunderclap.

spans.text: The door closes behind her like a thunderclap.

units.rawText: When he sticks his head out again, he sees Taranum anchoring herself by grabbing what looks like a handle on the wall. The lower half of her body is submerged in liquid Entropy, but she seems utterly unfazed.
units.displayText: When he sticks his head out again, he sees Taranum anchoring herself by grabbing what looks like a handle on the wall. The lower half of her body is submerged in liquid Entropy, but she seems utterly unfazed.
